questions.title: What if you hit your ball from the tee when it's not your turn?
questions.question: If you're playing a game where everyone adds up their own scores (stroke play), and you hit your ball from the tee before it is your turn, what happens?

choices.text: You have to hit your shot again and add one extra shot to your score.
Your shot counts and nothing happens.
You must hit your shot again, but you don't add any extra shots.

questions.explanation: In stroke play, if you hit your shot when it's not your turn, it's okay. Your shot counts and you do not get a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A type of golf game where you count every shot and see who has the lowest total in the end.
The place where you start each hole in golf.

questions.teachingTip: Remind children that the order is important for fairness, but making a mistake with the order in stroke play is not punished.
likelyMisconceptions: Some children may think they need to hit their shot again or get a penalty if they play in the wrong order.
Some may think they cannot finish the hole if they go in the wrong order.

questions.title: What happens if you tee off in the wrong order?
questions.question: In a stroke play competition, you accidentally play your tee shot before it's your turn. What is the correct outcome?

choices.text: You must replay the shot with a one-stroke penalty added.
The shot stands and there is no penalty.
You are disqualified from the hole.
You have to replay the shot, but there is no penalty.

questions.explanation: In stroke play, playing out of order is allowed and there is no penalty. Your shot counts as played.
